snippet.title: "Wabisabi SushiDerby" 2nd Trailer
snippet.description:
"Wabisabi SushiDerby"
Steam Store Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113050
Nintendo Switch™：https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/wabisabi-sushiderby-switch

Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

Title:Wabisabi SushiDerby
Platform:Steam、Nintendo Switch™
Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified. Traditional)
Genre:Sushi × Training × Racing
Launch Date:Wednesday, July 15, 2026
Players: 1
Developer:ITAMAE STUDIO（X：https://x.com/wabisabiderbyen ）
Publisher: Kodansha Ltd.
Copyright: ©ITAMAE STUDIO / KODANSHA
